title: Protocols end to end, transfer and bootstrap uncertainty

text.finding: Run end to end under both protocols, the six setups' Addis intercepts move by up to 5.4 µg/m³ (Biomass-smoke (906)) and by 0.03 for the AIRSpec-corrected OC/EC cohort: the protocol is a lever on raw spectra, not on corrected ones. The corrected intercept's site-cluster bootstrap interval is [-1.78, -1.17] site-held-out and [-2.07, -1.03] under the app protocol; raw-model residuals track the score-space distance D² (r 0.71–0.87) under either protocol, corrected-model residuals do not (r ≤ 0.33).
